headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: STEADYWRK API key — required only for dispatch.quote and dispatch.order; dispatch.evals and dispatch.index need no key

headerDocs.name: x-api-key
headerDocs.description: STEADYWRK API key — required only for dispatch.quote and dispatch.order; dispatch.evals and dispatch.index need no key

toolsPreview.name: dispatch.quote
toolsPreview.description: Return an instant dispatch quote for a field-service job. Accepts trade + location + urgency and returns matched contractor, estimated cost in cents, ETA tier, and valid_for_minutes.

toolsPreview.name: dispatch.order
toolsPreview.description: Create a dispatch work order. Auto-matches a contractor from the active pool and returns a tracked order with masked contractor reference and status URL.

toolsPreview.name: dispatch.evals
toolsPreview.description: Return the public evals dashboard: completion rate, NTE variance, dispatch latency, human-override rate, and operational counts for the selected rolling window. No API key required.

toolsPreview.name: dispatch.index
toolsPreview.description: Return the catalog of 8 dispatch trade verticals with baseline model rates (routine urgency, 1.0× multiplier). Rates are STEADYWRK model rates informed by BLS OES data — not BLS verbatim. No API key required.

toolsPreview.name: agentic.readiness_probe
toolsPreview.description: Free multi-surface storefront readiness snapshot (UCP/ACP discovery, product schema, robots, answer-engine maps). Not an attested Store Guard grade. Response includes a Store Guard $149 CTA. No API key required.
